title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: This document outlines the government's response to a report on artificial intelligence and public standards from 2020. The response includes the government's policies and actions to address the issues raised in the report.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education is considering its position on the use of generative artificial intelligence in education, weighing potential benefits and drawbacks. This policy aims to establish guidelines for the responsible use of generative AI in teaching and learning.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual will be responsible for regulating the use of artificial intelligence in qualifications to ensure its reliability and integrity. This policy aims to address concerns related to AI's impact on the qualifications sector in the UK.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document provides a report and assessment on the use of copyrighted materials in the development of artificial intelligence systems, exploring potential implications and consequences. It aims to examine the intersection of copyright law and AI technology, identifying key concerns and areas for further discussion.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The government is responding to a report on artificial intelligence from the House of Lords, addressing concerns and making moves to regulate AI in the UK. The government aims to ensure that AI development aligns with societal values and does not create unnecessary risks or challenges.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference for a committee reviewing artificial intelligence and its relationship with public standards, covering the scope and objectives of the review. It also provides frequently asked questions (FAQs) to guide the committee's work.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Centre for Science and Policy (CSPL) has provided written evidence to the UK's Science and Technology Committee regarding the governance of artificial intelligence. This submission aims to inform the committee's inquiry on the topic.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This document explores how artificial intelligence affects medical product regulation. It aims to implement the guidelines set forth in the Artificial Intelligence White Paper.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most efficient and effective in the world for its size, using artificial intelligence. It aims to achieve this through the development and use of trusted artificial intelligence systems.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This document outlines the government's plan to use artificial intelligence in transport in a way that maximizes benefits while minimizing risks. It describes the steps being taken by the Department for Transport (DfT) to work with the transport sector to harness the potential of AI.
